title: Crafter Autosetup by Blitzeer
description: A small mod that automatically toggles preset slots by simulating mouse clicks.
body:
_**Crafter Autosetup**_

Tired of manually enabling and disabling Crafter slots every time you place a new Crafter? This mod makes the process quick and effortless by automatically applying your preferred Crafter slot configuration whenever you open a Crafter.

**How to use:**

Use the config key (C by default, configurable in the keybind settings under "Gameplay") to open the CrafterConfigScreen, toggle the desired slots, and save your settings. When the mod is enabled, the saved configuration will be applied automatically whenever you open a Crafter. 

When GUI Scale is set to Auto, the mod may not render correctly across the entire screen. This issue will be fixed in the next update.
